tldr: Midday batch (Sep 9): A joint FBI/NSA/CISA advisory names six Chinese labs — DeepSeek, Moonshot, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI — for mining Claude, GPT, Gemini & Grok outputs since 2024 'likely with Chinese government awareness,' landing days before the Sep 24 Trump-Xi meeting. Ex-OpenAI/Anthropic pretraining lead Jacob Coxon resigns publicly, urging a temporary ban on capability gains as labs 'race to self-improving superintelligence.' Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome Atlas, AI predictions for all ~9B possible single-letter human DNA changes (1PB catalogue, free for academics). Inception Labs ships Mercury 2.5, the largest diffusion LLM trained — Haiku-class quality at 1,107 tok/s. Terence Tao warns AI is 'non-renewably mining' math's best problems post-Navier-Stokes; Qwen3.8-27B quant benchmarks show 4-bit holds while 1-bit collapses; Hermes Agent gains GPT-Image-2.5 via Codex and fal.

articles.title: Mercury 2.5: largest diffusion LLM yet, Haiku-class at 1,107 tok/s

articles.title: Tao: AI is 'non-renewably mining' math's best problems
articles.summary: On the Navier-Stokes saga: even a rumor that a problem is being worked triggers an AI stampede, so researchers stop sharing promising directions.

articles.title: Benchmarking Qwen3.8 27B quantizations: 4-bit holds up, 1-bit collapses
articles.summary: Quant shootout on Qwen3.8-27B: 4-bit keeps quality close to full precision while 1-bit degrades hard — guidance for memory-constrained local serving.

articles.summary: LLMs develop novel social biases through adaptive exploration, not just training-data mirroring — new angle on emergent agent behavior.
